title: Tal vez después
desc: A no you were given in March
setting: You have invited Julio to the lake three times since March. It is August.

steps.speaker: Julio
steps.es: Tal vez después, vos. Ahorita está complicado.
steps.en: Maybe later. Right now it is complicated.

options.es: Va pues. Cuando querrás, avisame vos.
options.en: Right then. Whenever you like, you let me know.
options.feedback: You heard the no and handed him the next move. Nothing is broken and nobody had to say it.
Fine. Otro día from you keeps the invitation alive slightly longer than it should be.

options.en: And next Sunday? And the one after?
options.feedback: Pushing past a soft no is the one thing it is designed to prevent.

steps.speaker: Julio
steps.es: Es que en estos meses ando corto.
steps.en: The thing is these months I am short.

options.es: Ah, va. Si es por eso, yo pongo la gasolina.
options.en: Ah, right. If that is it, I will put in the petrol.
options.feedback: He gave you the real reason, indirectly. Answering it without naming it is exactly right.
Kind and vague. He needs to know who is paying before he can say yes.

options.es: Pero si no cuesta casi nada.
options.feedback: To him it does. That sentence tells him you have not understood the last four months.

steps.speaker: Julio
steps.es: No, hombre, no es solo eso.
steps.en: No, man, it is not just that.

options.es: Está bien. No te estoy sacando nada.
options.en: All right. I am not trying to get anything out of you.
options.feedback: You let go of it cleanly. That sentence is what tells him the door stays open.
Fine. It leaves a small pull on him that he did not need.

options.en: Then tell me what it is.
options.feedback: He has now told you twice that he does not want to say. Asking a third time is the ofensa.

steps.speaker: Julio
steps.es: Para el veintitrés sí puedo. Ese domingo sí.
steps.en: On the twenty-third I can. That Sunday, yes.

options.en: The twenty-third then. That is settled.
options.feedback: He named a date, which is the only signal that ever meant yes. You closed it immediately.
Ahí vemos on a date he finally named puts the vagueness back in.
He gave you a date after five months. That is not the moment to doubt him out loud.
